official_definition: Time Vent - (When Attacks) By banishing 11 "Kamen" family cards from your Trash, the opponent sends their own cores to the Void until they have a total of four cores on their Grandwalker Nexuses/Field/Reserve/Trash. Neither player's effects can prevent this effect.

ownership_rules.native_syntax: Ability block header contains [Time Vent] or [Time Vent: Param]
ownership_rules.prose_exclusion: Mentions inside body clauses ("with [Time Vent]", "give [Time Vent]") classified as REFERENCES or GRANTED, never NATIVE.

resolution.description: Mutates game state as specified by official effect text.
